title: Result Record v0
$comment: AUDIT INFRASTRUCTURE ONLY (DevSpec Section 34). One record per fixture x lane execution. status distinguishes UNSUPPORTED / BLOCKED / FAIL_INVARIANT / ERROR_RUNTIME because they carry different architectural meaning: unsupported != failed. usage is provenance-aware and nullable: missing usage != zero usage.

observed_terminal_state.$comment: P0.6C additive. The provider/framework-native terminal signal, made queryable at the result level instead of only inside the transcript. result.status is the AUDIT verdict; this is the RUNTIME terminal state, a different axis. native preserves the raw terminal string; category is a coarse audit bucket; unknown natives are kept verbatim, never dropped.

observed_model_identity.$comment: P0.6D additive (finding N-05). Cross-lane model identity provenance, made queryable at the result level WITHOUT inspecting provider-specific raw payloads. The requested model (request-side configuration) is kept strictly separate from the observed returned model (a response-side observation); the returned model is NEVER assumed equal to the requested model, and a framework-exposed model id is NEVER assumed provider-native. No canonicalization is applied: exact observed strings are preserved (no lowercasing, alias resolution, snapshot stripping, or family inference). A populated observed_returned_model MUST carry an observed_returned_model_raw_ref (enforced by if/then below) unless it is null/unavailable. model_identity_match is an EXACT-STRING comparison only (true/false/unknown) and does NOT interpret a mismatch as an error.

requested_model.$comment: The explicit configured/requested model id placed into the probe request (DevSpec Section 29 'configured model id'). Request-side evidence; never overwritten by response metadata.

observed_returned_model.$comment: A model id actually observed in response-side evidence. Optional: null when the selected API/lane exposed no returned model id (recorded as unavailable, never copied from the requested model).

observed_returned_model_source.$comment: Centrally-owned provenance vocabulary (harness provenance.MODEL_IDENTITY_SOURCES). Offline synthetic evidence is fixture_expected; a live native provider field is provider_native; a live framework-metadata field is framework_native; absent is unavailable.

observed_returned_model_raw_ref.$comment: Pointer to the raw artifact that contains the observed field. Required when observed_returned_model is populated; null only when the value is unavailable.

execution_mode.$comment: Preserved alongside source: execution mode and source-provenance are related but distinct axes. Offline provider-shaped objects are fixture_expected, not real provider observations.

model_identity_match.$comment: Exact-string equality of requested vs observed. unknown when observed is unavailable or the requested model is unknown. Not an error signal.

usage.$comment: DevSpec Section 32. All token fields nullable; missing usage stays null, never 0. finality=partial when cancelled mid-stream. P0.6C: cache_read/cache_creation added so Anthropic's two-field cache split (and any provider's cache reads) survive into the summary instead of collapsing into a single OpenAI-shaped cached_input_tokens; reasoning_tokens carries Gemini thought tokens (normalization, documented in the gemini normalizer). `source` (P0.6C additive) answers 'reported by WHOM' — provenance answers 'reported vs estimated vs absent' — so framework-normalized usage is no longer indistinguishable from provider-native usage.

cached_input_tokens.$comment: Back-compat: equals cache_read_input_tokens. Retained so existing readers keep working.

source.$comment: Usage-token provenance vocabulary (harness/audit-scoped, see harness provenance module). provider_native = provider's own usage block; framework_native = a framework's normalized usage (e.g. LangChain usage_metadata); local_estimate = harness-computed; unavailable = no usage reported.
